messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout r-2026-03-21-47 started in eu-west1 at 14:20 UTC. Observability: 502 spike on canary instances, 45% error rate over 2m. Auto-paused at 14:22 UTC.
alex: seeing the 502s in traces, stack shows redis pool saturation + kvcache eviction storm. logs: `kvcache::evict 1.2s` repeatedly.
maria: p95 latency up ~800ms for canary; not just errors. Not safe to progress.
sam: I think we quarantine the release and pin traffic back to last stable (v1.4.2). We should not do full rollback yet until we confirm root cause.
priya: agree with quarantine. Options: 1) pin to v1.4.2 and re-run smoke in eu-west1, 2) reduce canary percent and toggle batching off for canary to see effect. Which do we want now?
luis: oncall - I'll own immediate ops. My vote: pin to v1.4.2, run quick smoke, then decide whether to requeue to next change window.
alex: to pin and pause from CLI:```/deploybot pause r-2026-03-21-47``` ```/deploybot pin r-2026-03-21-47 v1.4.2``` I'll run those now.
release-conductor: Heads up — next ideal change window is 03:00 UTC tomorrow. If we quarantine now we should aim to requeue for that window unless root cause is simple.
alex: done, ran pause + pin at 14:25 UTC. Deploybot confirmation: "rollout r-2026-03-21-47 paused; traffic pinned to v1.4.2" :white_check_mark:
maria: creating a short postmortem ticket and am updating the release notes to reflect the quarantine. Ticket: https://go/issues/RED-3121
sam: I'll prepare a canary rerun plan: reduce canary batch_size, disable automatic batching, and enable KV cache debug. Steps + smoke script in the ticket.
priya: also add a fallback policy to the rollout config so if kvcache eviction > 20% for 5m we auto-fallback to pinned version. Saves us manual intervention.
luis: agreed. I'll monitor redis and KVMetrics while Sam runs the rerun. Ping me when smoke starts.
alex: smoke rerun scheduled at 02:40 UTC (pre-change-window). If green, we queue for 03:00 UTC window with a soft ramp. If not, we keep quarantine and open a deeper RCA.
release-conductor: Noted. Action owners: Luis (ops monitoring), Alex (deploy actions), Sam (rerun plan + smoke), Maria (ticket + release note update), Priya (fallback policy PR). ETA for initial findings: +2h.
sam: quick ask - anyone see similar regression in staging? @qa didn't flag earlier.
priya: staging didn't hit the same load pattern; will add stress test to reproduce eviction pattern.
luis: thanks all. :thumbsup: Will post updates here; if anything changes I'll escalate to incident channel.
alex: leaving the pinned state and ticket links in the release page: https://go/releases/r-2026-03-21-47
maria: added brief note to product slack and docs. :memo:
deploybot: Reminder: paused rollouts will remain pinned until unpaused or unpinned by an authorized user.
release-conductor: Closing this thread for now — updates will be appended to the ticket and I'll post a summary once we have smoke results.
